title: Answer: consciousness belongs only to living systems, though not necessarily all of them

statements.text: Seth's biological naturalism holds that consciousness is a property of only, but not necessarily all, living systems. It probably feels like something to be a bat and probably not like anything to be a stone. The view does not hold that all life is conscious, and leaves open what tells conscious from non-conscious living systems.
statements.scope: Conscious artificial intelligence and biological naturalism (2025, accepted manuscript)
